purpose: Reusable desktop companions for a shared wallpaper-driven identity. These are real native render modes, not illustrations to paint into a window frame or bar.
constraints: Choose one mode per widget instance; multiple independent instances may use the same shared PipeWire spectrum.
Adapt rhythm, negative space, palette and light from the wallpaper. Never copy a depicted face, character, furniture or the conceptual preview background into the widget.
Keep desktop widgets out of work areas, icons, windows and reserved controls. Placement/output remains an explicit desktop-editor choice, never inferred from this catalogue.
Native desktop mode selection is visualization_mode. Preserve legacy rings, bars_rings, wave_rings and all settings outside these six references.
Spectrum means frequency bands, not PCM waveform. Mist uses chronological RMS energy history; no invented peaks in silence.
Motion-disabled policy stops autonomous rotation; new modes react to audio only. fade_when_idle=true hides idle widgets; false retains a stationary baseline or ornament.
Validate that the installed native shell offers the selected mode before applying a skin. This reference pack is not an installer or permission to change desktop configuration.

provenance.inspiration_scope: The upstream desktop ribbon concept; other shapes are locally designed references, not six upstream implementations.
provenance.preview_kind: synthetic concept illustration, NOT a native runtime capture

presets.name: Ленты / Ribbons
presets.structure: Three crossing interpolated ribbons plus one thin highlight; amplitude tapers to fixed endpoints.
presets.placement: Wide, quiet horizontal negative space; do not span a wallpaper focal subject.
presets.motion: Audio bends the lines; no free-running decorative oscillation.
presets.idle: Stationary central line when fade_when_idle is false.
presets.skin_translation: Flowing, fabric, water, aurora or calligraphic rhythm; colors follow primary and secondary roles, not compulsory cyan/pink.

presets.name: Спектральный контур / Spectral Contour
presets.signal: 32 smoothed current frequency bands, low to high from left to right; NOT PCM
presets.structure: One thin interpolated spectral ridge, restrained local glow, no layered ribbons.
presets.placement: Narrow horizontal ledge or margin with strong contrast and generous empty space.
presets.motion: Only frequency magnitude changes the contour.
presets.skin_translation: Fine engraving, technical outline, horizon or luminous thread; avoid giant solid filled graphs.

presets.name: Радиальные полосы / Radial Bars
presets.signal: 32 smoothed current frequency bands mirrored around a circle
presets.structure: Separated radial bars surrounding clear negative space. Fits the smaller box dimension without stretching into an ellipse.
presets.placement: Isolated circular emblem zone, not over a face or an interactive desktop element.
presets.motion: Band magnitude extends bars; rotation_speed controls optional autonomous rotation and can be zero.
presets.idle: Stationary short radial crown when retained.
presets.skin_translation: Instrument, seal, halo or mechanical rhythm; do not imply a play button or click action.

presets.name: Кольцо-волна / Wave Ring
presets.signal: Interpolated frequency bands wrapped and mirrored around a circle; NOT an oscilloscope
presets.structure: Continuous spectral annulus with a bright outer edge and transparent center; aspect-safe in a rectangular widget.
presets.placement: Calm circular halo zone with sufficient empty space around its loudest radius.
presets.motion: Spectrum deforms the outer ring; optional rotation is separately controllable.
presets.skin_translation: Soft halo, portal, eclipse or liquid rim; never require the wallpaper to contain a literal circle.

presets.name: Туманные гряды / Mist Ridges
presets.signal: 128 chronological RMS-energy samples at 50ms (6.4 seconds), oldest left, newest right
presets.structure: Three translucent layered ridges from the SAME real energy history, not three arbitrary noise mountains.
presets.placement: Wide shallow landscape-like lower negative space; taper edges rather than covering screen width indiscriminately.
presets.motion: Time sampling carries real pulses leftward. A repaint without elapsed time does not move history; idle clears it.
presets.idle: Flat stationary ridges when retained; no phantom mountains.
presets.skin_translation: Mist, dunes, ink wash or translucent strata. Palette roles determine depth and light; an invented landscape is not mandatory.

presets.name: Реактивный орнамент / Reactive Ornament
presets.signal: Low/mid/high frequency energy derived from the shared spectrum
presets.structure: Three fixed anchors with hanging lines, two diamond pendants and one circular pendant, bounded rays and glow.
presets.placement: Tall or square decorative margin with room below anchors; no fake controls, no wallpaper furniture dependency.
presets.motion: Energy causes small bounded pendant deflection and light. Anchors do not drift; no independent idle pendulum.
presets.skin_translation: Jewelry, wind-chime rhythm, etched sigils or sparse hanging geometry. Transfer material and spacing, not literal objects from the GIF.
